text: So many splits. Which one is actually right for you?
First, count the days you can really train. Not the dream number.
Three days: full body. Four days: upper lower. Five days: the hybrid. Six days: push, pull, legs.
And random workouts with no plan? That's the worst split of all. You can't progress what you don't repeat.
Pick one, and stick with it for at least two months. Save this.
